docs.04-primitives.md claim section: document max age (4 TTLs, at most 4 h, restarted by claim or renew), absorbed_paths, previous_owner, and the lost field on every response
docs.AGENTS.md lease paragraph: one sentence: long sessions re-claim or renew every four TTLs; a `lost` field means stop editing those paths

server.rs.budget: lost is bounded by the paths the agent held; both fields are omitted when empty so unaffected responses do not grow
server.rs.claim ok result: adds `previous_owner: [{path, owner, reaped_at}]` when non-empty and `absorbed_paths` when non-empty (Granted already serializes it)
server.rs.every tool result: if let lost = state.take_lost(&agent) and !lost.is_empty(): add `lost: [{path, owner, at}]` to the outcome JSON (seconds-precision timestamps) and prefix the text line with `warning: lost lease on <n> path(s); `

state.rs.Inner: gains `reaped: Reaped` (not persisted, not on Snapshot or Delta)
state.rs.State::access (or wherever reap+touch ru: let expired = inner.claims.reap(now); if !expired.is_empty() { inner.reaped.record(&expired, now); mark claims dirty }; then touch as today
state.rs.State::claim: after a successful ClaimBook::claim, for each new_path look up inner.reaped.previous_owner(path); return Granted plus Vec<(RepoPath, LostLease)> as `previous: Vec<PreviousOwner>` (new struct in state.rs or claims.rs: {path, owner, reaped_at})
state.rs.State::take_lost: fn take_lost(&self, agent: &AgentId) -> Vec<LostLease>  // Reaped::take_for, called once per tool call by the server after the handler ran

current.notes: Domain half is in src/claims.rs (released after the full suite passes). Wiring is small: one reap hook, one take_lost call in the result path, one lookup in claim. Tests to add in tests/http_roundtrip.rs with the injected clock: an agent whose lease expired sees `lost` exactly once on its next call; a second agent claiming that path sees previous_owner; touch past 4 TTLs expires the lease. Whoever holds state.rs and server.rs next may apply this; otherwise head-dev-fable takes a window after ci-speedup.
